_meta.description: Homebody seed product sample: real Amazon-sold furniture from the CC BY 4.0 Amazon Berkeley Objects dataset, each with a to-scale glTF 3D model.
_meta.license: CC BY 4.0. Attribution required: "Amazon.com" for data, images and 3D models. See docs/reference/sourcing/README.md.
caveats: No prices in the dataset; price_usd is null until a live lookup.
Snapshot is several years old; many ASINs may be discontinued.
Images: image_url is the CC BY archive copy (256px); image_url_cdn is Amazon CDN, not guaranteed stable.
All products are Amazon private labels (Rivet, Stone & Beam, Ravenna Home, AmazonBasics) plus a few third parties, so this is a mid-market slice only.
_meta.homebody_block: Each item has a "homebody" block shaped like lib/play/products.json (meters, material ids from lib/taste/visual.ts). Tags are guesses to review.
